nonblocking_findings.description: This derived page (DESIGN_SOURCE.json:17 maps it to docs/MANAGEMENT.md) now states "Profile create/update uses the current versioned request schema described in the [directional profile guide] before requesting tokens. Other resource mutations retain their existing request schemas", while its authoritative source docs/MANAGEMENT.md:46 still says "Create/update requests use the frozen native schemas before requesting tokens." The site sentence is the accurate one (crates/scm-sdk/src/airs/management/profiles.rs:91,214 validate typescript:0.35.0:CreateSecurityProfileRequestSchema), so the authoritative repository guide is the stale copy. The same page also gained a wholly site-only section at lines 9-14 ("Directional profiles in 0.2.4", "These additions are available in the published 0.2.4 crate") with no counterpart in docs/MANAGEMENT.md, which contains no occurrence of "directional", "content_type" or "dlp_tenant_id". docs/GITHUB_MIRROR.md:129-136 makes repository guides authoritative and requires updating both copies in the same change and reviewing them for semantic agreement, and docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json:48 repeats that policy. The change already demonstrates the correct mechanism for an in-scope repository-guide augmentation at docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json:96-107 (docs/developer/security.md with repositorySourceSha256, a derivation note, and docs/SECURITY.md included in the whitespace check at attempt-04.checks.json:50), but docs/MANAGEMENT.md received neither the text nor a provenance record, and docs-site/docs/airs/management.md has no entry in release024DerivedSources.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Either add the equivalent directional paragraph to docs/MANAGEMENT.md (replacing the stale "frozen native schemas" sentence at line 46) and register docs-site/docs/airs/management.md in docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json release024DerivedSources with sourcePath docs/MANAGEMENT.md, sourceCommit 6f18529a47cc273feca1000af6e4fc0d96da757e, repositorySourceSha256 for the augmented guide and a derivation note mirroring lines 96-107, adding docs/MANAGEMENT.md to the git diff --check path list in docs-site/scripts/review-release-024.py:388-389; or, if the repository guide must stay byte-identical to the published source, record docs-site/docs/airs/management.md as an explicitly site-only augmentation in release024DerivedSources and state there that docs/MANAGEMENT.md:46 is superseded for profile create/update by the published 0.2.4 behavior.

nonblocking_findings.description: release024DerivedSources registers only the four derived pages whose published repository guides changed (response-defaults, stability, live-qualification, security). Three further derived pages carry new site-only 0.2.4 text whose authoritative guides have no equivalent: docs-site/docs/core/models.md:108-110 and docs-site/docs/core/validation.md:150-152 ("For the 0.2.4 profile projections and current versioned request roots..."; docs/MODELS.md and docs/VALIDATION.md contain no match for "directional" or "0.35.0") and docs-site/docs/developer/parity.md:18-24 ("## TypeScript 0.35.0 profile addition"; docs/EXPORTS.md contains no match for "0.35.0" or "directional"). The statements themselves are accurate - existing model SCHEMA identities do retain their historical bindings (crates/scm-sdk/src/models/generated.rs:13543) and the additive ledger is separate - but a later release update cannot tell from the manifest which site paragraphs have no authoritative source, which is exactly the drift the guideUpdatePolicy at line 48 is meant to prevent.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Add entries for docs/core/models.md, docs/core/validation.md and docs/developer/parity.md to docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json release024DerivedSources, each naming its sourcePath (docs/MODELS.md, docs/VALIDATION.md, docs/EXPORTS.md), the sourceCommit, and a derivation field stating that the 0.2.4 cross-reference paragraph is a site-only forward reference to docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md with no repository-guide counterpart.

nonblocking_findings.description: REFERENCES pins only docs/DIRECTIONAL_PROFILES.md, docs/STABILITY.md, docs/SECURITY.md and CHANGELOG.md among the authoritative guides, so the attempt manifest (docs/reviews/github-pages/release-0.2.4/attempt-04.source.json:81-85) binds no digest for docs/MANAGEMENT.md, docs/MODELS.md, docs/VALIDATION.md or docs/EXPORTS.md even though their derived pages changed in this scope. The helper therefore cannot detect or freeze divergence between a changed derived page and its authoritative source, and a reviewer must discover it by hand (as in the medium finding above). snapshot() at line 226 would include them automatically once they are listed.
nonblocking_findings.required_fix: Extend REFERENCES (or derive it from docs-site/DESIGN_SOURCE.json derivedFrom for every page whose digest differs from the baseline) so each authoritative source of a changed derived page is bound in the manifest, and add a unit test in docs-site/scripts/test_review_release_024.py asserting that every release024DerivedSources sourcePath appears in snapshot()['files'].
